title: Filling gaps for the libre sensor
symptom: The user asks about handling gaps in Libre sensor data when using xDrip with Blucon or scanning. Specifically, they ask what to show when a user scans twice within 5 minutes, how to avoid gaps when scanning after 7 minutes, and how to handle a 60-minute disconnection of Blucon where the 15-minute data points may cause rejection of current readings.
evidence_quote: The trivial solution to these problems is calculating the per 5 minutes data and having xDrip reject points that are more than 4 minutes apart. Does anyone has a better solution?
